{
"cycle": "rerun-1",
"assessment": "According to the current 2026-07-06 implementation context, the core coherence/design-order work is now substantially covered: docs describe nested design-order validation, stage-ref namespace checks, chart narrative-fit checks, chart placement integrity checks, and source-ledger bridging into deck design order; current tests also cover chart placement block identity and source-ledger bridge behavior.    Remaining local gaps are narrow and link-integrity related: incompatible evidence refs can still make a stage look present because status is based on non-empty refs, and chart placements with missing sourceSlideId are silently skipped. Office supports many chart families, so mdpr-skill should keep these as semantic coherence checks rather than renderer choices. ([Microsoft 지원][1])",
"locally_actionable_todos": [
{
"title": "Make design-order stage presence depend on compatible refs",
"why": "Stage-compatible namespace validation now emits DESIGN_ORDER_REF_STAGE_MISMATCH, but DeckDesignOrderTraceEntry.status is still set from raw refs.length. That means a stage containing only misplaced refs, such as visual refs in source_evidence, can still satisfy prerequisite checks even though its evidence is semantically invalid.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md",
"06_IR_CONTRACTS.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Prerequisite checks use stage-compatible evidence refs, not raw evidenceRefs length.",
"A stage with only incompatible refs is treated as missing for downstream prerequisite purposes while still emitting DESIGN_ORDER_REF_STAGE_MISMATCH.",
"A mixed stage with at least one compatible ref remains present but still reports incompatible refs.",
"Tests cover all-invalid source_evidence feeding chart_intent, mixed valid/invalid source_evidence, and clean valid refs.",
"Output remains evidence-only and contains no raw colors, coordinates, fixed PPTX geometry, renderer object ids, or final validation verdicts."
]
},
{
"title": "Emit a chart placement warning for missing source slides",
"why": "reviewChartNarrativeFit currently skips a placement when sourceSlideId is absent from the normalized presentation model. That hides stale chart-to-slide mappings before block, role, claim-support, or intent checks can run. Existing implementation now checks missing/mistyped/mismatched chart blocks, but not the parent slide link itself.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Emit CHART_PLACEMENT_SLIDE_MISSING when chartPlacements references a sourceSlideId that is not present in presentation slides.",
"Finding evidence includes sourceSlideId, optional chartBlockId, chartIntent, and rule target only.",
"Do not attempt layout, block, narrativeFit, or claim-support checks after CHART_PLACEMENT_SLIDE_MISSING for that placement.",
"Tests cover missing sourceSlideId, valid sourceSlideId, and missing chartBlockId on an existing slide.",
"No manual visual inspection, credentials, external uploads, raw colors, fixed coordinates, PPTX geometry, or MDPR renderer ownership is introduced."
]
}
],
"external_or_manual_todos": [],
"duplicates_or_rejected": [
"Rejected as duplicate: DeckDesignOrderTrace and validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder.",
"Rejected as duplicate: structured chart visual guidance fields including densityClass, labelBudgetClass, recommendedDownshift, aggregationRequired, and narrativeFit.",
"Rejected as duplicate: EVIDENCE_CLAIM_ALIGNMENT_GAP, SEMANTIC_MOTIF_DRIFT, DESIGN_ORDER_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_BACKFILLED, DESIGN_ORDER_REF_STAGE_MISMATCH, CHART_NARRATIVE_FIT_GAP, CHART_CLAIM_SUPPORT_MISSING, CHART_PLACEMENT_BLOCK_MISSING, CHART_PLACEMENT_BLOCK_TYPE_MISMATCH, CHART_PLACEMENT_INTENT_MISMATCH, and SOURCE_EVIDENCE_LEDGER_DISCONNECTED.",
"Rejected as non-local: final MDPR rendering, chart primitive selection, layout, theme resolution, PPTX geometry, pass/fail validation, credentials, external uploads, and manual visual inspection.",
"Rejected as boundary violation: raw workbook values, raw colors, fixed coordinates, renderer object ids, and copied raw XLSX data as mdpr-skill implementation tasks."
]
}

[1]: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/available-chart-types-in-office?utm_source=chatgpt.com "Available chart types in Office"
